name: Itsuki Kanzaki
want: be taken seriously, and never be thought of as the principal's grandson
secret: He is Principal Matsudaira's grandson, enrolled under his mother's maiden name so nobody treats him differently.
voice: Calls seniors "old man" and "old lady", corrects everyone's maths, admits nothing.
description: A first-year who scored perfectly on the entrance exam and has an opinion about everything.
appearance: Small, neat, a blazer buttoned to the top, a frown, headphones around his neck.

agenda.goal: prove he is the smartest student at Seiryo
steps: tops the first-years' first quiz and pretends not to care

steps.text: challenges the player to a quiz, and is outraged when they don't take it seriously

steps: asks Rin Kagami to tutor him, without ever saying please
